title: Pet-Friendly Condo | Free Parking | Near BNA
description:
Enjoy an easy Nashville stay in this modern industrial, ground-floor 1-bedroom condo. You’ll be about 5 miles from Broadway, 3 miles from the Gulch, and a quick drive from BNA. The bedroom has a queen bed, while the living room includes a queen-size sofa bed for up to 4 guests. Enjoy a full kitchen with granite counters and stainless appliances, in-unit washer and dryer, free parking, private entrance, and pet-friendly convenience—without the downtown parking hassle.

The space
Welcome to our modern industrial condo, a stylish retreat in the heart of Nashville! This one-bedroom gem features sleek stainless steel appliances, stunning granite countertops, and a cozy living area with a queen-size pull-out couch. The bedroom offers a plush queen bed for a restful night’s sleep. Refresh in the tiled walk-in shower.

Guest access
Enjoy the entire condo to yourselves and the ability to park anywhere in our parking garage lot.
